company.name: ClassIn
company.shortDescription: ClassIn is an online platform that provides solutions for virtual learning and online merge offline services.
company.description: ClassIn offers a rounded learning ecosystem for interactive blackboards, break-out rooms, teaching tools, resource centers, and attendance. They provide quantifiable learning behaviors in and outside the classroom. If anyone wants to contact them please contact them via email.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based interactive classroom for synchronous online teaching, with tools for whiteboarding, screen sharing, group work, chat, media, assessments, recording, and class administration.
productsAndServices.name: ClassIn Virtual Classroom

productsAndServices.description: A hybrid teaching solution that connects in-person and remote learners through live classes, classroom capture, interactive teaching tools, recordings, and learning management features.
productsAndServices.name: ClassIn Hybrid Learning

productsAndServices.description: Administrative and learning-management capabilities for scheduling lessons, assigning teachers, organizing resources, managing homework and tests, tracking progress, and generating learning reports.
productsAndServices.name: ClassIn Learning and School Management

productsAndServices.description: Learning Tools Interoperability integrations that connect ClassIn with learning platforms and calendars for class scheduling, classroom access, recordings, schedules, and learning analytics.
productsAndServices.name: ClassIn LTI Integrations

productsAndServices.description: Developer integration capabilities that allow education technology and software providers to incorporate ClassIn classroom and learning functions into their own applications and workflows.
productsAndServices.name: ClassIn SDK and API Integration Services

productsAndServices.description: A Windows application that connects physical classrooms to ClassIn’s cloud environment, enabling schools to deliver and manage hybrid lessons.
productsAndServices.name: ClassIn X for Classrooms
